lines.en: label chikainvite1:
I tap on Chika’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Chika 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I’ve been thinking lately that it might be safe for her to come visit the house soon.
lines.zh: 我最近在琢磨，也许再过不久，让她来家里拜访就算安全了。

lines.en: Obviously, Ami might show some opposition to it, but would she really be skeptical of something going on between {i}Chika{/i} and me?
lines.zh: 当然，Ami 可能会有所反对，但她真会怀疑我和 {i}Chika{/i} 之间有什么吗？

lines.en: Now that I think of it, I can’t even remember any situations where the two of them have talked to one another.
lines.zh: 现在想想，我甚至想不起她们俩什么时候交谈过。

lines.en: And that’s not to say I don’t think they’d get along or anything.
lines.zh: 这倒不是说我觉得她们合不来什么的。

lines.en: It’s just...a strange combination.
lines.zh: 只是……这搭配挺奇怪的。

lines.en: Ami probably doesn’t even realize that Chika and I are on {i}good terms{/i} with each other.
lines.zh: Ami 大概压根不知道我和 Chika {i}关系不错{/i}。

lines.en: if invitetip == False:
call invitetip from _call_invitetip_1
scene noonsky
: Hihi~ What’s up, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗨嗨～怎么啦，Sensei？

lines.en: : Hey. Do you have any plans tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今晚有安排吗？

lines.en: : Tonight? Not really. I’m just hanging out in the dorm right now.
lines.zh: : 今晚？没有啊。我眼下就在宿舍里待着。

lines.en: : Yumi’s with Chinami so I’ve got the night to myself.
lines.zh: : Yumi 陪着 Chinami，所以今晚就我自己。

lines.en: : Which means I’m totally free if you wanna come over~
lines.zh: : 也就是说，你要想过来我完全有空哦～

lines.en: : Actually, how would {i}you{/i} feel about coming over to my place?
lines.zh: : 其实，{i}你{/i}愿不愿意来我家？

lines.en: : Are you coming over or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来？

lines.en: : Of course I am!
lines.zh: : 当然来！

lines.en: : But isn’t Ami a little smarter than you’re letting on? Are you sure she won’t get the wrong idea or whatever?
lines.zh: : 可 Ami 不是比你表现出来的要聪明一点吗？你确定她不会误会什么的？

lines.en: : I can’t even mention another girl without her getting the wrong idea, so she probably will.
lines.zh: : 我连提别的女孩一句她都会多想，所以她多半会。

lines.en: : But maybe if we just act really casual about it, she won’t even notice?
lines.zh: : 不过要是我们表现得特别随意，她也许压根不会察觉？

lines.en: : Seems like wishful thinking to me...but I’m up for a little risk! I like her anyway.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这有点一厢情愿……不过我愿意冒点险！反正我挺喜欢她的。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you two were friends.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你们俩是朋友。

lines.en: : We’re not.
lines.zh: : 我们不是。

lines.en: : Yet!
lines.zh: : 现在还不是！

lines.en: : See ya, Sensei~ Text me your address!
lines.zh: : 回见，Sensei～把你地址发给我！

lines.en: scene black
Chika hangs up the phone and I type out my address to her.
lines.zh: Chika 挂了电话，我把地址打了发给她。

lines.en: I decide to give Ami a warning as well so that, if Chika manages to somehow get ready and make it to my place before me, she isn’t entirely too surprised.
lines.zh: 我决定也给 Ami 打个招呼，这样万一 Chika 动作快、先我一步到了我家，她也不至于太吃惊。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit1
: Umm...would you mind explaining to me why both you {i}and{/i} Chika texted me about her coming over tonight?...
lines.zh: : 呃……你能不能跟我解释一下，为什么你{i}和{/i} Chika 都发短信告诉我她今晚要过来？……

lines.en: : She texted you as well? I didn’t tell her to do that.
lines.zh: : 她也给你发了？我可没让她这么做。

lines.en: : She must have thought it was weird that her {i}teacher{/i} was inviting her to his house.
lines.zh: : 她大概是觉得，{i}老师{/i}邀请学生去他家这事有点怪吧。

lines.en: : Do you also think it’s weird, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你也觉得怪吗，Ami？

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit2
: Of course I do! You have me!
lines.zh: : 当然怪了！你有我啊！

lines.en: : And why Chika of all people?!
lines.zh: : 而且为什么偏偏是 Chika？！

lines.en: : You don’t have a problem with her, do you?
lines.zh: : 你对她没意见吧？

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit3
: Well...no.
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有。

lines.en: : She’s really nice and...popular and...pretty much everyone likes her now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 她人很好，而且……很受欢迎……现在想想，差不多所有人都喜欢她。

lines.en: : I just don’t understand why she’s coming to our house all of a sudden. I didn’t even know you two knew each other.
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白她为什么突然要来我们家。我都不知道你们俩认识。

lines.en: : Of course we know each other. She’s in the class.
lines.zh: : 我们当然认识。她就在班里。

lines.en: : I could invite over pretty much anyone from there and it wouldn’t be {i}completely{/i} random.
lines.zh: : 班里随便哪个人我都可以邀请过来，也不算{i}多{/i}突兀。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit4
: I don’t recall giving you permission to start inviting all of the other girls over, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不记得允许过你把别的女孩都往家里请，Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t like this at all. Cancel your plans.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不喜欢这样。取消你的计划。

lines.en: The doorbell suddenly rings.
lines.zh: 门铃突然响了。

lines.en: : Damn. If only you would have told me to cancel them a few minutes earlier.
lines.zh: : 啧。你要是早几分钟叫我取消就好了。

lines.en: : It would be rude to turn her away after she came all the way here, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 她大老远跑来了，再把她拒之门外就太失礼了，不是吗？

lines.en: : I’ll tell her if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 你要是不好意思开口，我去跟她说。

lines.en: : No need. Come on in, Chika!
lines.zh: : 不用。进来吧，Chika！

lines.en: I ignore Ami’s suggestion and shout at the door to let Chika know that it’s [[mostly] safe for her to enter.
lines.zh: 我没理 Ami 的提议，朝门口喊了一声，让 Chika 知道现在进来[[基本]安全。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit5
: Hey! Long time, no see!
lines.zh: : 嘿！好久不见！

lines.en: : Yeah...hey.
: Thanks for...letting me know you were coming over? I think?
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……提前告诉我你要来？大概吧？

lines.en: : Well it would obvs be pretty weird if I were to just come over and hang out with your [uncle] without you at least knowing about it.
lines.zh: : 毕竟要是我就这么跑来跟你的[叔叔]玩，却连你都不知情，那也太奇怪了。

lines.en: : But rest assured, I’m here for you just as much as I am for him.
lines.zh: : 不过放心，我来这儿一半是为了你，一半是为了他。

lines.en: : You are?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : You are?...
scene chikafirstvisit6
: Obviously!
lines.zh: : 当然啦！

lines.en: : Ami lives here too, so we’ve gotta include her in any conversation that you and I have together or she’ll get all dejected and left out and stuff.
lines.zh: : Ami 也住这儿，所以我们俩聊天也得带上她，不然她会失落、觉得被冷落什么的。

lines.en: : I appreciate all you do for me as a teacher, Sensei, but I don’t really think I’m comfortable being alone with you just yet.
lines.zh: : 我很感谢你作为老师为我做的一切，Sensei，不过我暂时还不太放心跟你单独相处。

lines.en: : Not saying you think about me that way or anything, but you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 不是说你会对我有那种想法，但你懂我意思。

lines.en: Jesus. Someone give this girl an Oscar.
lines.zh: 天哪。谁给这姑娘颁个奥斯卡吧。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: I was skeptical at first...but when she puts it like that, maybe this isn’t as weird as I thought?
lines.zh: : 我一开始还挺怀疑的……不过她这么一说，也许这事没我想的那么怪？

lines.en: : Chika's obviously out of your league anyway. So I don’t know what I was even worried about in the first place.
lines.zh: : 反正 Chika 显然比你高好几个段位。所以我都不知道一开始在担心什么。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit7
: Aww come on...don’t flatter me like that. I don’t even have a league.
lines.zh: : 哎呀别这样……别这么夸我。我根本没什么段位。

lines.en: : I’m just regular old Chika.
lines.zh: : 我就是普普通通的 Chika 而已。

lines.en: : Don’t be so humble. You’re out of everyone’s league.
lines.zh: : 别这么谦虚。你比谁都高段位。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t even waste your time talking to someone like Sensei when there are zillions of other boys who’d be much better for you.
lines.zh: : 有那么多比 Sensei 强得多的男生，你根本不该浪费时间跟他这种人说话。

lines.en: : Well, at least there were until the space war. I guess your options are a bit more limited now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少在太空战争之前是那样。我猜你现在的选择少了一些。

lines.en: : Still better than Sensei, though.
lines.zh: : 不过还是比 Sensei 强。

lines.en: : You do realize I’m right here, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你知道我就站在旁边吧？

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit8
: Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然知道！

lines.en: Chika flashes me a look that seems to be a cross of “I’m so sorry” and “There’s no way I agree with her,” but the looming thought of being underappreciated by my very own [niece] eats away at me.
lines.zh: Chika 向我投来一个介于「真对不起」和「我才不认同她」之间的眼神，但「被我自己的[侄女]看轻」这个念头挥之不去，啃噬着我。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit9
: So...now what?
lines.zh: : 那……现在干嘛？

lines.en: : Yes, now what?
lines.zh: : 对啊，现在干嘛？

lines.en: : Since I’m apparently needed in order for this little hang-out session, may I offer a suggestion?
lines.zh: : 既然这场小小的聚会显然需要我，我能提个建议吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Even though you just insulted me in front of a guest.
lines.zh: : 可以。虽然你刚当着客人的面损了我。

lines.en: It’s not like I had a plan in mind for this evening anyway. I’m just glad I was able to get Chika inside without much resistance.
lines.zh: 反正我今晚本来也没什么计划。能没费什么劲就把 Chika 请进门，我已经很高兴了。

lines.en: But I guess that’s one of the benefits to her being liked by pretty much everyone.
lines.zh: 不过我想，这大概就是人人都喜欢她的好处之一。

lines.en: And also apparently one of the bright sides to being “out of her league...”
lines.zh: 而且显然，这也是「段位配不上她」的好处之一……

lines.en: : How about we show Chika the best part of our house?
lines.zh: : 不如我们带 Chika 参观一下我们家最棒的地方？

lines.en: : You mean my bed?
lines.zh: : 你是说我的床？

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit10
: No! I don’t mean your stupid bed!
lines.zh: : 不是！我才不是说你那张蠢床！

lines.en: : I mean our TV! The one that we watch movies on all the time!
lines.zh: : 我是说我们的电视！就是我们老用来看电影的那台！

lines.en: : I like my bed a little more than the TV.
lines.zh: : 我的床比电视更得我心。

lines.en: : You’re not showing Chika your bed!
lines.zh: : 你不许带 Chika 看你床！

lines.en: : Hahaha...I’m...fine with TV...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……我……看电视挺好的……

lines.en: : My legs are kind of tired from walking all the way here and whatnot anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我一路走过来腿也有点累了什么的。

lines.en: scene black
Ami shoots me one final death glare before moving to the living room and taking her place on the couch.
lines.zh: Ami 最后瞪了我一眼，然后走进客厅，在沙发上坐定。

lines.en: Chika sits on the opposite end, leaving the space in the middle completely unoccupied.
lines.zh: Chika 坐在另一头，把中间的位置完全空了出来。

lines.en: Before Ami is able to slide over and prevent me from sitting directly next to Chika, I manage to find my place between the two of them.
lines.zh: 趁 Ami 还没滑过去挡住我坐在 Chika 正旁边，我先一步在她们俩中间落了座。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit11
: Wow! This is so much bigger than the one at my place!
lines.zh: : 哇！这比我家的那台大多了！

lines.en: : You can even hear it without having to turn the volume all the way up!
lines.zh: : 而且不用把音量开到最大都能听清！

lines.en: : The glories of surround-sound.
lines.zh: : 环绕立体声的妙处。

lines.en: : I thought surround-sound was something only rich people could afford.
lines.zh: : 我还以为环绕立体声是有钱人才买得起的东西。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit12
: Are you guys really that well off, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你们家真有那么富裕吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Not particularly. I don’t even remember what all of this cost us.
lines.zh: : 算不上。我都记不清这些花了多少钱。

lines.en: Mostly due to the fact that I’m not technically the one who paid for everything.
lines.zh: 主要是因为，严格来说这些东西不是我掏钱买的。

lines.en: Well, I guess...technically, I {i}am{/i}.
lines.zh: 嗯，不过……严格来说，又{i}是{/i}我。

lines.en: But a different...me. Or something.
lines.zh: 但是是另一个……我。差不多吧。

lines.en: Wait, why am I thinking about the cost of our entertainment set-up when I’m sandwiched between two cute [teenager]s?
lines.zh: 等等，我都被两个可爱的[青少年]夹在中间了，干嘛还在想娱乐设备花了多少钱？

lines.en: : Sensei and I used to spend almost every day on this couch.
lines.zh: : Sensei 和我以前几乎每天都在这张沙发上度过。

lines.en: : But now that I’m getting older, he’s losing interest in me and inviting other girls over to the house instead.
lines.zh: : 但现在我渐渐长大了，他对我失去了兴趣，转而邀请别的女孩来家里。

lines.en: : You need to cherish your family, Sensei. You never know when something bad might happen to them.
lines.zh: : 你得珍惜家人，Sensei。你永远不知道坏事什么时候会降临到他们头上。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit13
: Listen to your guest, Sensei. Cherish me more! Buy me things!
lines.zh: : 听你客人的话，Sensei。多珍惜我一点！给我买东西！

lines.en: : Who invited you here, Ami?
lines.zh: : 谁请你过来的，Ami？

lines.en: : Chika did! You’re not insinuating that {i}your{/i} guest might have made some sort of mistake, are you?
lines.zh: : Chika 请的！你该不会在暗示{i}你的{/i}客人犯了什么错误吧？

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I’m insinuating. Go to your room.
lines.zh: : 我暗示的正是这个。回你房间去。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit14
: Mmm!
: Now, now...I didn’t mean to stir up any trouble between you two. I just think things like this are more fun when everyone can enjoy them together.
lines.zh: : 好了好了……我不是故意挑你们俩吵架的。我只是觉得这种事大家一起享受才有意思。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit15
: I kind of wish my little sister could be here to experience this today.
lines.zh: : 我有点希望我妹妹今天也能在这儿感受这一切。

lines.en: The wording of that sentence makes it sound as if Chinami is dead. What a horrible thought.
lines.zh: 这句话的措辞听起来就好像 Chinami 死了似的。多么可怕的念头。

lines.en: : The only family I really have left is her and Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我真正剩下的家人只有她和 Yumi。

lines.en: Chinami lives again. What a joyous occasion.
lines.zh: Chinami 又活了。真是可喜可贺。

lines.en: : My only family is Sensei, so I can relate to that...
lines.zh: : 我唯一的家人就是 Sensei，所以我能理解那种感觉……

lines.en: : I didn’t know you had a sister, Chika. All this time I thought you were an only child.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你有个妹妹，Chika。这么久以来我一直以为你是独生女。

lines.en: : Two sisters if you count Yumi.
lines.zh: : 算上 Yumi 就是两个。

lines.en: : She’s independent, but I feel like she’s even more of a kid than my actual little sister at times.
lines.zh: : 她是很独立，但我总觉得她有时候比我亲妹妹还像小孩。

lines.en: : If Chinami ever starts talking like Yumi, though, I’m never coming over again.
lines.zh: : 不过要是 Chinami 哪天说话变得像 Yumi，我就再也不来了。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit16
: Wait! Coming over?!
lines.zh: : 等等！来我家？！

lines.en: : You’ve been to Chika’s house?!
lines.zh: : 你去过 Chika 家？！

lines.en: : You met her sister?!
lines.zh: : 你见过她妹妹？！

lines.en: : What else are you hiding from me, bastard-[uncle]?!
lines.zh: : 你还瞒着我什么，混蛋[叔叔]？！

lines.en: : Ah- Nononononono, you’ve got it all wrong! Sensei’s never come to my house before.
lines.zh: : 啊——不不不不不，你完全想岔了！Sensei 从没来过我家。

lines.en: : He meant...coming to the mall! The store I work at! I bring my sister with me sometimes when I can’t find a babysitter!
lines.zh: : 他说的是……来商场！我上班的那家店！我找不到人看孩子的时候，有时候会带妹妹一起去！

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit17
: Wait just a second...
lines.zh: : 等一下……

lines.en: : Little sister...
lines.zh: : 妹妹……

lines.en: : Mall...
lines.zh: : 商场……

lines.en: : Does she perhaps...wear a funny-looking...dog mask?
lines.zh: : 她是不是……戴着一个样子很滑稽的……狗面具？

lines.en: : Hahaha...yeah...that’s...a thing she does...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……对……她确实……会戴那玩意儿……

lines.en: : I was beginning to think you were never going to bring up that incident.
lines.zh: : 我都开始以为你永远不会提那件事了。

lines.en: : Up until now, I’d been pretending it was all some strange delusion due to lack of sleep.
lines.zh: : 一直以来，我都在假装那只是缺觉产生的某种奇怪幻觉。

lines.en: : Something about this story doesn’t add up, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这事有点说不通。

lines.en: : What?...What could possibly not add up about...this?...
lines.zh: : 什么？……这……有什么说不通的地方？……

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit18
: If you two don’t normally spend time alone together...why are you going to visit her at the mall?
lines.zh: : 要是你们俩平时不单独相处……那你为什么会去商场找她？

lines.en: : And why are you watching her little sister while she works?
lines.zh: : 而且你为什么在她上班的时候帮她看妹妹？

lines.en: : Just how close are you two?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底有多熟？

lines.en: : Umm...uhh...
: I have a passion for luxury clothing.
lines.zh: : 我对奢侈品服装很有热情。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit19
: Y-Yes! That’s exactly it!
lines.zh: : 对——对！就是这个原因！

lines.en: : Sensei is a regular customer! The only times I ever see him are at[school] and work, though...
lines.zh: : Sensei 是我们店的常客！不过我见到他的机会也只有[学校]和上班时间……

lines.en: : He’s never invited me to the house before, so I wouldn’t have really felt comfortable unless you were here as well, Ami!
lines.zh: : 他以前从没邀请我来过家里，所以要是你不在场，Ami，我是不太会放心的！

lines.en: : If you’re so passionate about luxury clothes, how come you wear that same stupid blazer every day?
lines.zh: : 你要是对奢侈品服装这么有热情，怎么天天穿同一件蠢西装外套？

lines.en: : Stupid?
: He’s...saving up money to take you on a trip!
lines.zh: : 他……在攒钱要带你出去旅游！

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit20
: A trip? Really?
lines.zh: : 旅游？真的吗？

lines.en: : Where are we going?
lines.zh: : 我们要去哪儿？

lines.en: : The...moon!
lines.zh: : 去……月球！

lines.en: : We’re going to...the moon?
lines.zh: : 我们要去……月球？

lines.en: : Yes.
Really, Chika? The moon?
lines.zh: 真的假的，Chika？月球？

lines.en: Couldn’t you have at least named somewhere on this planet?
lines.zh: 你就不能报个这个星球上的地方吗？

lines.en: How much money am I going to need to save up now?
lines.zh: 这下我得攒多少钱才够？

lines.en: I can feel my fake passion for luxury clothing diminishing by the moment.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到自己对奢侈品服装的假热情正在逐秒消退。

lines.en: : I...don’t know if I want to go to the moon, though.
lines.zh: : 我……不确定我想不想去月球。

lines.en: : That seems like it would take a really long time.
lines.zh: : 感觉那要花好久好久。

lines.en: : Damn. I guess I’ll need to cancel our plans then.
lines.zh: : 啧。那我只能把计划取消了。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit21
: Well...I mean...I {i}would{/i} get to be alone with you...so maybe it wouldn’t be all that bad in the end.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说……{i}能{/i}跟你单独相处……所以最后可能也没那么糟。

lines.en: : Too late. I’ve already cancelled the trip.
lines.zh: : 太迟了。我已经把旅行取消了。

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit22
: What?! Already?! But I changed my mind!
lines.zh: : 什么？！已经取消了？！可我改主意了！

lines.en: : I want to go to the moon!
lines.zh: : 我要去月球！

lines.en: : Hahaha...hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈哈……

lines.en: : Hah...
scene chikafirstvisit23
: Mmm...
: {i}The moon? Really?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}月球？真的假的？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It was all I could think of on such short notice.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}情急之下我只能想到这个。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How were you so good at lying up until that part?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在那之前怎么谎话说得那么溜？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I had a script in my head. The trip part was all improv.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}前面我脑子里是有台词的。旅游那部分全是即兴发挥。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Was it really? I had absolutely no idea.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是吗？我完全没看出来。{/i}

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit24
: {i}I’ll make it up to you...kay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会补偿你的……好吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Invite me over again when Ami isn’t home and you’ll see~{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等 Ami 不在家的时候再请我过来，你就知道了～{/i}

lines.en: scene chikafirstvisit25
: Hey...what are you two whispering about over there?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你们俩在那边嘀咕什么呢？

lines.en: : W-Whispering? No one’s whispering! We were sitting here in silence!
lines.zh: : 嘀——嘀咕？没人嘀咕！我们只是安静地坐着！

lines.en: : I think we need to take you to a psychiatrist, Ami. You appear to be hearing things.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们得带你去看心理医生了，Ami。你好像出现幻听了。

lines.en: : No! You appear to be {i}hiding{/i} things!
lines.zh: : 才不是！是你在{i}隐瞒{/i}事情！

lines.en: : Tell me what you were whispering about!
lines.zh: : 告诉我你们刚才嘀咕什么！

lines.en: scene black
Obviously, we never tell Ami what we were whispering about.
lines.zh: 当然，我们始终没告诉 Ami 我们在嘀咕什么。

lines.en: It takes her roughly fifteen minutes to give up on asking.
lines.zh: 她大概问了十五分钟才放弃。

lines.en: Within that time, Chika and I mutually decide that it might be best if she heads back to the dorm early today.
lines.zh: 这段时间里，Chika 和我心照不宣地决定，她今天最好早点回宿舍。

lines.en: I feel a little bad for having her come all the way here just to leave shortly after, but I guess things like that can’t be avoided at times.
lines.zh: 让她大老远跑来却待不了多久就走，我有点过意不去，不过我想这种事有时在所难免。

lines.en: I’ll just need to make sure Ami isn’t around the next time I invite Chika over so we don’t have to go through something like this again...
lines.zh: 下次我再请 Chika 来，得先确保 Ami 不在场，这样就不用再经历这种事了……

label invitetip:
{i}Welcome to the invite over tooltip!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到「邀请到家里」功能说明！{/i}

lines.en: {i}In Lessons in Love, you have the option to invite characters over during nights to increase your level with them in either affection or lust.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在《Lessons in Love》中，你可以在夜间邀请角色来家里，以提升你对他们的好感或欲望。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Before you’re able to choose, though, you must play through both of the respective character’s invite-over introductory events.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过在选择之前，你必须先过完对应角色的两个「邀请到家里」引导事件。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The first one will be meant to introduce them to your house-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第一个是让他们初次来到你家——{/i}

lines.en: {i}And the second one will be reserved for performing sex acts with/on them!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第二个则是跟他们发生/对其发生性行为！{/i}

lines.en: {i}After that, you’ll be able to choose between affection or lust each time you invite them over, and gain a bonus of 3 points in whichever stat you decide on.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}之后，每次邀请他们来家里，你都可以在好感或欲望之间做选择，并在你选定的属性上获得 3 点加成。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can even change the outfits they wear during the invite-over animations based on how high your affection or lust level is with them!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你甚至可以根据你对他们的好感或欲望等级，更换他们在邀请动画中的服装！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Invite over events will be colored light blue in the event tracker, so you’ll always know when a new one is available.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}邀请事件在事件追踪器中会显示为浅蓝色，所以你总能知道什么时候有新的可用。{/i}

lines.en: {i}More are sure to pop up over time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}之后肯定还会陆续出现更多。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Since I suppose that’s all you really need to know for now, I’ll let you get back to the game!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我想你现在需要知道的就这些了，那我就让你回到游戏里吧！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Thanks as always for playing!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一如既往，感谢游玩！{/i}

lines.en: $ invitetip = True
